profile_text.body:
Micron Technology Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boise, Idaho, traded under the ticker MU. On its own site the company describes itself as a global leader in memory and storage, powering AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge with semiconductor solutions. Its site offers data sheets, design tools and technical documentation, a Technology Enablement Program (TEP), sample ordering, and sales support, and it states that mobile memory and storage accelerate AI-driven technologies.

The harvested material does not list specific Micron products, and no MCP servers or lawsuits are recorded. The only litigation-related fact is a law exposure count of 21 in Idaho.
